name: Moritz Köhler
headline: Commercial Program Management | Merck Life Science | Pharma Biotech | CEMS MBA at UoC & ESADE
summary:
Associate Director Commercial Program Management at Merck Life Science. Leading international commercial excellence projects to drive growth in our global biotech CDMO and contract testing service business (mAbs, mRNA, Viral Gene Therapy, Antibody Drug Conjugates) helping our Biotech and Pharma customers worldwide to develop and commercialize novel therapies for millions of patients around the world. 

Experienced in strategy, marketing, sales, data analytics, and program/project management. Enthusiastic about diving into & solving diverse business or scientific challenges in innovative environments.

Dual business and supply chain management background from the University of Cologne (CEMS M.Sc. in Supply Chain Management) and the ESADE Business School Barcelona (CEMS M.Sc. in International Management) with cross-industry consulting experience.

positions.title: Associate Director Commercial Program Management
positions.description:
Leading commercial excellence initiatives for the MarCom, marketing, and sales teams of our global CDMO and contract testing service business improving our multi-channel go-to-market approach working directly with our commercial teams and biotech/pharma customers worldwide. 
Marketing | Sales | Multi-Channel MarCom | Go-to-Market | CRM | Commercial Excellence | Project Management

Data Analytics | Business Insights | KPIs & Holistic Steering Frameworks | Forecasting & Planning | Process Excellence | Project Management

Developing strategies and leading cross-business strategic projects for our global CDMO service business, which is serving biotech/pharma customers worldwide to develop and commercialize their ADC, HPAPI, mAbs, mRNA, Viral Vector therapies for patients around the world. 
Strategy Development | Market Analysis | Voice-of-Customer | Financial Modelling | Make-or-Buy-or-Partner | Project Management

positions.title: CEO Office Belen Garijo | Assignment
positions.description:
The Merck Group has a history of over 350 years in the space of Science & Technology - It is the parent organization of our Healthcare, Life Science and Electronics divisions.

Part of Merck Group CEO Belen Garijo’s office for her first 120 CEO days including the preparation & moderation of internal and external executive meetings & events, the finalization of the Merck Group's portfolio & strategy cycle, and the initiation of our new Merck Group Priorities.

positions.title: Life Science Strategic Marketing | Assignment
positions.description:
Merck Life Science is Merck’s division that empowers the global scientific communities in the pharma, biotech, diagnostics and other industries with tools, services & digital platforms to develop, produce and apply breakthrough therapies.

Part of the Process Solutions Strategic Marketing team working on market insights / VoC studies, leading a make-or-buy business case, and drive the development of an inorganic growth strategy for Merck Life Science.

positions.title: Healthcare Strategy | Assignment
positions.description:
Merck Healthcare is Merck’s division that develops and commercializes therapies globally for millions of patients in the fields of oncology, neurology & immunology, fertility, endocrinology, and general medicine.

Part of the Strategy team that works with various Healthcare departments on Merck’s global development, clinical and commercial strategy to ensure that we continue and expand to provide existing and novel therapies for millions of patients around the world.

positions.title: Inhouse Consulting | Global Graduate Program
positions.description: "The Global Graduate Program (GGP) is the company’s career accelerator for high potential graduates who are early in their careers. company.name: Merck Life Science
company.description:
Together with our colleagues, customers and stakeholders, we impact life and health with science. Before researchers can make scientific breakthroughs, they must have access to state-of-the-art tools, services and expertise to perform experiments and engineer new products. That’s where we come in.

We offer one of the broadest portfolios in the industry for scientists, best-in-class products for pharmaceutical development and manufacturing, and a fully integrated service organization to support CDMO and contract testing across traditional and novel modalities.

Our vision is a world where our innovative products, services and digital offerings help create solutions for people globally and a sustainable future for generations to come.

Merck is a global science and technology company with around 60,000 employees in more than 66 countries. 

Not intended for US & CA visitors.
